args.body:
Hello,

Two things on our open business with you, as soon as you can please.

1. Quote Q-YZ-26-0831 (HR-40110, HR-40120, HR-40130, HR-40210) is shown as valid to 13 October. Please confirm in writing whether the quoted prices and conditions can be held beyond 13 October, and to what date.

2. Following your force majeure notice of 22 September, please give us a revised promise date for each open line below, and tell us what quantity you can commit to us on each. This is a request for information only; it does not waive any of Halden's rights under the contract.

HR-40110: HPO-26-00450/10 (355 EA), HPO-26-00614/10 (435 EA), HPO-26-00614/20 (350 EA, currently promised 26 October)
HR-40120: HPO-26-00450/20 (445 EA), HPO-26-00670/10 (400 EA, currently promised 30 October)
HR-40130: HPO-26-00532/10 (1,320 EA), HPO-26-00670/20 (1,030 EA, currently promised 24 November)
HR-40210: HPO-26-00532/20 (163 EA, currently promised 30 September), HPO-26-00532/30 (144 EA, currently promised 26 November)

Thank you,
Halden Robotics Purchasing
